title: Microsoft Teams: Voice phishing detection for external calls
description: Voice phishing detection helps protect Microsoft Teams users from potential scams during one-to-one calls with people outside their organization. Using AI, Teams analyzes conversations for signs of social engineering and alerts recipients when suspicious activity is detected, helping them recognize potential threats and decide how to proceed.
